production_layers.name: client_experience
production_layers.rationale: User-facing experience must expose the promised outcome with accessible states.
production_layers.verification: Run UI tests and capture a screenshot or accessibility snapshot.

production_layers.name: application_core
production_layers.rationale: Core domain logic must be isolated from presentation and infrastructure.
production_layers.verification: Run unit and integration tests for core workflows.

production_layers.name: data_model
production_layers.rationale: Data shape, tenancy, migrations, and invariants must be explicit.

production_layers.name: auth_permissions
production_layers.rationale: Identity and permission boundaries must fail closed.
production_layers.verification: Run authz and negative permission tests.

production_layers.name: external_integrations
production_layers.rationale: External contracts need typed boundaries, retries, and failure handling.
production_layers.verification: Run contract or mocked integration tests.

production_layers.name: hosting_runtime
production_layers.rationale: Runtime environment must be reproducible and configurable.
production_layers.verification: Run quickstart and environment validation gates.

production_layers.name: ci_cd
production_layers.rationale: Build, test, and release path must be repeatable.

production_layers.name: security_supply_chain
production_layers.rationale: Secrets, dependency, and supply-chain exposure must be checked before ship.
production_layers.verification: Run security, OSV, and guarddog gates where applicable.

production_layers.name: rate_limiting
production_layers.rationale: HTTP and external action surfaces need abuse protection or a signed deferral.

production_layers.name: caching_cdn
production_layers.rationale: Repeated reads and static assets need explicit cache behavior or a signed deferral.

production_layers.name: scaling_capacity
production_layers.rationale: Capacity limit and scale trigger must be named before traffic arrives.
production_layers.verification: Run performance gate and read capacity assumptions.

production_layers.name: observability_support
production_layers.rationale: Operators need logs, metrics, traces, support path, and alert ownership.

production_layers.name: backup_restore_dr
production_layers.rationale: Recovery path, RTO/RPO, and restore proof must be explicit for live systems.
production_layers.verification: Run release and restore-proof gates where applicable.
